text: dsh-skill-manager 是面向 DSH 网页端的技能管理插件，在独立技能页面列出当前会话可见的技能，并提供全局、项目和会话三级启停控制。停用项会从模型技能目录中过滤，并由 skill 工具调用守卫拦截；页面还支持按名称或描述搜索、批量操作和自定义分类。开关与分类保存在本机状态文件中，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-skill-manager adds a Skills page to DSH web. It lists skills and supports global, project, and session toggles. Disabled skills leave the model catalog and are blocked when called. Search and custom categories are included. State is local; no API key or external service is needed.

dsh-skill-manager 的功能「分范围控制技能」：在独立技能页面查看技能，并按全局、项目或会话启用或停用；停用项会从模型目录隐藏，调用时也会被拦截。
dsh-skill-manager 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 19 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-skill-manager README · dsh-skill-manager：A standalone Skills page for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh): every skill in one list with an enable checkbox. A skill you uncheck leaves the model's catalog and is refused by the `skill` tool, so a long skill collection stops costing context and stops getting invoked by accident.

dsh-skill-manager README · What it does：- **List** — every skill the harness can see, with a Chinese description for each.
- **Enable / disable** — three scopes: 全局 (global), 本项目 (this project's working directory), 本会话 (this session). Narrower scopes only add restrictions.
- **Categories** — group skills into named categories you create; purely visual, never changes what the model sees.
- **Search** — filters by name, description and Chinese description.
- **Separate page** — registers a `main` panel with its own sidebar entry, so it is not a cell inside the conversation.
dsh-skill-manager README · What it does：Disabled skills are filtered out of `ctx.skills.snapshot()` and blocked by a `ctx.tools.guard()` on the `skill` tool.

dsh-skill-manager README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package-or-github-url>
```

Or in the desktop app: Settings → Plugins → install from a path or URL.
dsh-skill-manager README · HTTP bridge：The panel talks to its host half over `/api/dsh-skill-manager/{list,toggle,groups}`, served by the harness web server.

dsh-skill-manager README · Development：Host JS is imported once per process: after editing `index.js`, disable and re-enable the plugin entry to reload it. Client JS reloads with a page refresh.

`node smoke.mjs` runs a headless test of the client component tree (mini React runtime, fake fetch).
